narrative:
Coshocton County has 21,627 registered voters, with 18.3% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 34.2% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 43.1%, a clear Democratic lean of 8.9 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 31.0% of registrants.
